name: big-project-constructor
description: Project memory for non-technical builders. Sets up a weeks-long project with an AI assistant so every conversation picks up exactly where the last one left off: a folder of plain files, a five-minute setup, and a short end-of-session ritual that saves everything.

interface.shortDescription: Keeps a weeks-long project coherent across every conversation. No coding required.
interface.longDescription: Starting something big with an AI assistant goes well for a day and then falls apart: every new conversation starts from scratch, decisions scatter across old chats, and by week three nobody can say what the current state is. Big Project Constructor fixes that. A five-minute setup turns your idea into a project folder with a topic structure, an instruction file the assistant reads every session, and a running log plus a current-state summary for each topic. You work one question at a time; the assistant flags decisions as they happen; and when you say 'wrap it up' it saves everything and hands you the prompt for next time. Works for a business, a book, a podcast, a renovation, a job search, or an app. Built from the process notes of a year of real projects.
defaultPrompt: I'm starting a big project and want help keeping it organized over the next few weeks
